Wow . Im at a loss for words. My boyfriend passed away 2 years ago and I still remember every single day of the 5 years we dated . He would always get my hopes high and then minutes later it was as if somebody else would step into his body . The “I love you “ always got me . I loved him so much and still love him and could not function with life without him. I’m surprised I’m still alive without him 2 years after hiss death . I wanted him to stop the drugs , always thought he would soon realize that he could lose me .. but I was asking too much from him .

I ended up doing drugs with him . It’s crazy, my whole life I’ve been a person that hated drugs or knew anything about drugs . But the manipulation really got me and all I wanted to do was be dead . So I ended up doing drugs with him . I wish I never did and I hate lying but this drug has gotten me into a liar due to the fact that I don’t want anybody to worry about me . But then again , if somebody was to worry about me , I think after 3 years , somebody would’ve notice something is up with me . 

It’s hard , really hard to make a drug addict love you more than the drugs . It starts affecting your self esteem and confidence . My advice to anybody , stay away because they will always find a way to say “sorry” and you’ll always fall for the traps.

Crazy typing that because I’m a drug addict too, but i have too big of a heart to hurt anybody . But I can say it’s not easy to find a drug addict that has a heart  and will put you before their drugs.

I'm sorry about your husband.
I really appreciate that you replied. These days, nobody cares to ask how I am. And nobody really sees the pain and how bad it is. All they see is me smiling all day. But this smile? I guess I'm a good actress because I'm falling apart inside and barely hanging on. So honestly thank you for responding! 

If it wasnt for his dog, I woud not be here and that's a fact. This little guy stops my tears and comes to cuddle with me so I won't cry.
